Star Wars Customizable Card Game - Premiere Edition
Decipher- 1995

Note:  Decipher Cards offered excellent checklists and spoiler lists at their  website, now 
maintained at the SWCCG website.  However, I have also been asked questions about 
which and how many cards were included in the "introductory two-player" card boxes for 
Premiere and Hoth (Empire Strikes Back), and that information could not be gleaned from 
Decipher's posted checklists.  My set is not complete, so I am short on key statistics (beyond 
the basics) for Rares.   Except for the "sort by rarity" section, I separate the "Light Side" and 
"Dark Side" cards, which have different back designs, and note in the titles where the 
same-named cards are found in both "decks."

The Limited (black border) and Unlimited (white border) cards are the same.  Some common
cards were found in the Premiere Star Wars 2-player introductory boxes, and these appear
to be identical to the Unlimited cards.  The introductory boxes include six cards from the
Premiere arc that are not found elsewhere.  Some common cards were found in the Empire
Strikes Back 2-player introductory boxes, and those cards are the same except that they
show a 1996 copyright date instead of 1995.  The "Starter" column indicates how many
cards are found in the 2-player decks, e.g., "S2" means there were two copies of the card
in the Star Wars 2-player boxes and "E3" means there were three copies of the card in the
Empire Strikes Back 2-player boxes. Booster boxes contain 36 packs of 15 cards each.

For character and vehicle attributes, I use these abbreviations: Stats: 1st space is Power,
2nd space is Ability, 3rd space is Force Affinity (A=attuned, S=sensitive, J=Jedi, M=Jedi
Master). For vehicles and droids, 2nd space is Armor or Maneuver and 3rd space is speed
(H=hyperspeed, L=landspeed). Cost: 1st space is Deploy Cost, 2nd space is Forfeit Value.
